source_note: Preserved executable from the initial direct-start experiment, not rebuilt for this validation. Core changes were uncommitted at build time and subsequently recorded in 03a416f. Original build source diff and compiler cache remain in the parent manifest; see direct_initialization_20261010_provenance.json. Validation harness was uncommitted at preparation; its content is pinned above.
interpretation: All 568 steps strictly converged below 1e-3; DIRECT used the previous state at all 280 eligible steps.
Whole-period flux/periodic-centered-difference EMF/harmonics pass. Large steps validate aligned flux only.
Full-period reduction 39.15%; 30-degree timing difference 0.59% is not a robust speedup, with increased outer iterations and unequal higher background load.
Light UI/MCP development and tests overlapped the early portion; no heavy packaging/build/other solver was launched during the suite. Estimated background load is retained for every run.
Memory peaks are process RSS/private values, not OS kernel pools or a standalone proof of leak absence.
No predictor, Anderson, default change, main merge, push or release is part of this result.
